An analysis of the company's financial profile reveals significant credit risk. While the company is currently profitable (operating margin of 8% and net income of $142M) and maintains adequate short-term liquidity (current ratio of 1.32), its balance sheet is highly leveraged with an equity-to-assets ratio of only 18% (shareholders' equity of $1,804M against $10,022M in assets). Furthermore, the deeply negative retained earnings of -$748M indicate a history of cumulative losses or aggressive capital restructurings, which places the credit profile firmly in the non-investment grade (speculative) category, specifically at the upper end of the highly speculative tier.

DECISION: B+
